laws.rule: In Papuk Nature Park, camping and fires are permitted only in designated places, and swimming in lakes is prohibited. The park crosses Požega-Slavonia and Virovitica-Podravina counties; these rules apply only within the park.
laws.heading: Papuk Nature Park rules and regulations

laws.rule: In Papuk Nature Park, dogs must be on a lead. Visitors must not pick plants, disturb animals or damage nests. These park rules do not apply across the whole county.
laws.heading: Papuk Nature Park rules and regulations

laws.rule: Papuk Nature Park says permission from park management is required to use photographs taken in the park for commercial purposes.
laws.heading: Papuk Nature Park rules and regulations

laws.rule: Papuk Nature Park says permission from park management is required to use videos taken in the park for commercial purposes.
